subject: Grifon live companion prototype
stage: Standalone live browser interaction and five-reaction study; chat integration remains a separate stage
appearance: Real 3D geometry with camera-projected Cycles lighting textures from the approved master. Fixed camera; limited gaze/head deformation. Not free-view, dynamic relighting, GLB or Gaussian splatting.

runtime.dependency_scope: Locally vendored in this prototype; no root package changes

vendor_patch: Removed one space before a tab in three.core.js SkinnedMesh material assignment indentation to pass the repository whitespace check. No semantic changes.
interaction: Honest still fallback and retry on load, context or render failure

blink.reason: The closed hold preserves the approved fully closed pose under normal browser frame sampling.
blink.continuity: Natural blink timing and in-progress closure persist across reaction changes, repeated state requests and Preview all; pause/reduced-motion guards remain active.

states.listening: Attentive head tilt and raised wing beside cheek
states.reading: Left wing holds a message card below the face; right wing advances through its text. Focused downward attention, natural blink and occasional user glance.
states.working: Alternating wing tips contact separate illuminated keys on a tilted gold control pad
states.ready: Raised wings and a brief perk/blink

reactions.reading_pose: 1.14 by 0.44 message card; inverse wing-tip contact at its surface. Reading-only 10% local-Z wing unfolding around fixed shoulders moves shell, gold interior and fibers together; original geometry files unchanged. Full card header stays below the face. Other states retain extension 1.
reactions.transitions: 400ms smooth crossfade from the current blended pose; shared wing, inner-wing and fiber transforms
reactions.tour: Preview all runs about three seconds per state and ends Idle; manual selection cancels; pause freezes progress; disabled with reduced motion
reactions.truthfulness: Manual previews only. Listening does not activate a microphone; Working does not run an agent task.
reactions.reference: reaction-reference.webp preserves the original approved Listening/Working reference
reactions.body_bake: baked-body-clean.png removes stationary wing texture ghosts while wings move; idle retains original baked-skin.png

preview.note: Open on the host computer or its remote desktop. This localhost URL is not a public phone URL; the server must remain running.

replay.assets: Copy baked-hero.png from the frozen skill's griffin-master-v05-hero.png and neutral.png from the accepted rig. Include this directory's runtime and vendor files alongside the newly exported scene.json, scene.bin and baked-skin.png.
replay.source_safety: Export opens the accepted rig but never saves over it. Refuses an output directory containing scene.bin.
replay.browser_smoke: Start the local server, then run node assets/3d-lab/grifon-companion-live/qa/reading-held/scoped-smoke.cjs using installed Playwright and Edge. candidate-capture.cjs records a 12-second Reading hold and mobile/desktop screenshots; pass a new prefix to preserve existing evidence. Check harness paths when moving workspaces.
replay.reaction_body_bake: blender --background --python-exit-code 1 --python bake-reaction-body.py -- RIG_BLEND FRESH_OUTPUT_PNG; opens source read-only in practice, never saves it, refuses existing output and verifies source hash unchanged
